name: Heal
description: A gold ground ring opens, a soft pillar of light rises, a luminous ribbon spirals twice around the target and a soft core of light swells at the peak.

metadata.analysis: Base variant: the concept sheet's six keyframes at full strength; the sheet's cross-shaped light core is a soft luminous core here (user feedback).
